difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the quasi-compact objects situation the class of modules admitting a finite cokernel presentation by direct images j_{U!}O_U along basis members is closed under extensions. The proof takes a short exact sequence whose outer terms have such presentations, names finite presentations for both, uses surjectivity of the middle map to choose coverings of the basis members indexing the presentation of the third term, and then assembles the two presentations into one for the middle term by the four-lemma style diagram chase that the section's earlier refinement lemma is designed to support (proof lines 5635-5670). H2: the assembly of the two presentations and the covering choices inside the quasi-compact situation are the substance, and the argument is written out rather than reduced to a citation.
